pages: INFINITY® SYSTEM CONTROL REGISTRATION INSTRUCTIONS from the Infinity System Control Step 1 Once the installation is complete and connection to the home network and the Carrier server has been established, touch the Infinity System Control anywhere on the Home screen. Note: You can check the status of the connections to the home network and Carrier server by touching the “view remote access status” option above the “remote access setup information” shown in Step 5. Step 4 From the second menu screen, select the Wireless icon. Step 2 Select Menu. Step 5 From the Wi-Fi® Setup screen, select the remote access setup information option. Step 3 Press the down arrow in the lower right hand corner of the first menu screen in order to get to the second menu screen. Step 6 Write down the serial number, MAC address and PIN information included on this screen as you will need this information when you log into the my.carrier.com website. Note: If you do not wish to write this information down, you can also take a photo of this screen using your smart phone to use as a visual reference when you are entering the website.

Step 1 From your mobile device, download the Carrier SmartHome app from either the App Store or Google Play. Note: Registration requires the serial number, MAC address and PIN information from your control (see Side 1, Step 6 for reference). INFINITY SYSTEM CONTROL REGISTRATION INSTRUCTIONS from the Carrier SmartHome app Step 4 To complete your registration, enter the verification code sent to the email address provided and tap Verify. Step 7 Next, you will be directed to the Carrier SmartHome app main screen where you will add your device to the app. Step 2 Tap Create Account. This will begin the registration process. Step 3 On the Create Account page, enter your account information. Please ensure you meet all password requirements then tap Create Account. Step 5 Next, you will enter your home location details on the My Home screen then tap Continue. You can enter your address manually or tap “Find Your Location” for automatic detection. Step 6 For enhanced security and faster access, we recommend enabling fingerprint or facial recognition (biometrics). Select Enable or Maybe Later.
